scope: Approval of revised test-only gameplan, not execution, runtime proof, or performance gate closure.

resolved.resolution: Mandatory independently expected A/B text on the actual edited owned-node button, full fixture node-set/ownership integrity checks, and INCOMPLETE on missing or stale state/DOM evidence resolve the visual observability loophole.

Fresh rendered-view layout-effect commit, observer arming before dispatch, explicit mounted document/draft/generation identity, sequential rAF callbacks with fresh performance.now endpoint, and fail-closed interruption handling resolve stale-commit and timer acceptance ambiguity.

assessment: Fixture pinning, 500 actual unique rendered owned nodes, 100 warmups followed by 1000 sequential real changeModule edits and target transitions are explicitly required.
Unrounded nearest-rank p95 strictly below 50 ms governs warm PASS; slow valid runs remain FAIL and invalid runs remain INCOMPLETE. Samples cannot be selectively discarded.
Production React build and reversible same-origin temporary test asset serving are specified without production source or security bypass changes.
Separate cold-start and authoritative diagnostic obligations remain open even with warm PASS; physical display, manual AT, solver and commercial claims remain excluded.
Lean now explicitly models two callback events and externally supplied validity/percentile. Its limitations are accurately stated and its approval is not a runtime proof.
